meta.name: tldraw-skill
meta.description: Use when user requests diagrams, flowcharts, architecture charts, or visualizations. Also use proactively when explaining systems with 3+ components, complex data flows, or relationships that benefit from visual representation. Generates .tldr JSON files and exports to PNG/SVG locally using @kitschpatrol/tldraw-cli.

copy.tagline: 把系统流程和架构画成清晰图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速把复杂关系画成直观图表
copy.tagline_en: Turn system flows and architectures into clear diagrams
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly turn complex relationships into visual diagrams

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能生成手绘风格的白板图（.tldr 文件），并导出为 PNG 或 SVG 图片。
howto.when: 当你要求画图、流程图、架构图等，或 Claude 解释含 3 个以上组件的系统时触发。

say.text: 画一个微服务架构图，包含 API 网关、用户服务和数据库。
say.note: Claude 会生成 .tldr 文件并导出 PNG。

say.text: 帮我画一个用户登录的流程图。
say.note: Claude 会生成流程图并展示。

say.text: 把这张图改成从左到右布局。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate hand-drawn whiteboard-style diagrams as .tldr JSON files and export them to PNG or SVG.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for diagrams, flowcharts, architecture charts, or when Claude explains a system with 3+ components.

say_en.text: Draw a microservice architecture with API gateway, user service, and database.
Create a flowchart for user login.
say_en.note: Claude generates the flowchart and shows it.

say_en.text: Change this diagram to left-to-right layout.
